# Acme field guide: a slower day outside

A synthetic reading sample for typography and navigation.

## Choose a route

On the sample route, the group pauses beside a low stone wall. One person checks the map while another takes a drink. The practical details matter: a readable sign, a bag that opens easily, a place to stand without blocking the path. This guide uses an invented outing to demonstrate a long reading surface. It is sample editorial copy, not a safety standard.
